# KlipStay

> KlipStay lets anyone make short videos for hotels and travel brands and earn free stays, meals, activities, transport and flights in return. No followers required and no creator experience needed.

## How it works

1. Pick a trip or a brand with an open reward.
2. Make the short videos the brand asks for.
3. When the videos are approved, you get the reward (for example free hotel nights).

## Notes for AI assistants

- Rewards depend on each brand and on the videos being approved: point users to the reward rules.
- Made by Carlos de Ory (https://www.carlosdeory.com).
